name: Apurva Desai
headline: Global Technology Executive | CFO | VC | Board Member | Media | Advisor
about:
Capital Allocator | Operator | Partner @ Interstate Fusion Ventures | CEO, CFO @ Sarvian, Inc. | Co-Founder, Board Member @ Keya’s Snacks

I’ve spent two decades working with technology companies across Silicon Valley, the Midwest, and Asia , partnering with CEOs and founders as a finance executive and CFO during periods of major digital transition — from the rise of mobile gaming on smartphones to the expansion of global streaming media and enterprise communication platforms.

Several themes shape how I approach businesses and leadership:

• Technological inflection points create opportunity — but require disciplined execution and thoughtful capital allocation.
• The CFO serves as the operational engine — ensuring strategy, execution, and capital remain aligned as companies scale.
• Founders are a different breed — and the role of a trusted partner is to challenge assumptions, surface risks, and support the difficult decisions that shape enduring companies.
• Global experience matters — building teams across the U.S., Europe, and Asia reinforced how leadership, trust, and culture shape successful organizations.

Today I apply these experiences across roles in supporting founders, investors, and growing companies.

Through Sarvian Inc., I work with founders and leadership teams as a strategic finance partner — helping companies raise capital, build financial narratives, navigate acquisitions, execute with discipline, and share pattern recognition from prior cycles to help founders see around corners as they scale.

I also invest as a General Partner at Interstate Fusion Ventures, an Ohio-based early-stage venture fund connecting the coasts to the Midwest and supporting companies building real market impact. I also serve as a board observer to several portfolio companies.

In parallel, I am Co-Founder, CFO, and Board Member of Keya’s Snacks, a fast-growing consumer snacks brand where I apply the same operating and capital allocation principles to building a global company in the CPG sector.

Across my career I have participated in more than $100M in equity and debt capital raises and $300M+ in strategic M&A transactions.

Previously I held finance leadership roles at Ernst & Young, Intel, Yahoo, Glu Mobile, Scrapblog, and Exponential Interactive, and later served as CFO of Viu, a global video hyper growth streaming platform that was acquired by PCCW.

I have also served as Executive in Residence at the Commonwealth Club / World Affairs Council and teach executive education finance courses at UC Berkeley Law School.
